data.exact_reserve_text: The PI excess of loss account saw a negative gross incurred claims movement of GBP 4.0m and the syndicate's exposure was materially reduced in 2012. Reinsurance mitigates the impact but additional adjustment premiums are payable.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports material prior-year adverse development in its professional indemnity excess of loss account, noting a negative gross incurred claims movement (reported as GBP 4.0m) and referencing legacy exposure reductions in 2012; reinsurance mitigates some of the impact but additional adjustment premiums are payable. Overall calendar year 2014 produced a loss and written premiums of approx. GBP 39.5m.
raw_causal_phrases: negative gross incurred claims movement of GBP 4.0m
syndicate's exposure was materially reduced in 2012
reinsurance mitigates the impact but additional adjustment premiums are payable
data.data_quality_notes: Document pages are rotated scanned images and OCR is incomplete. Opening reserves were taken from the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column but the exact gross claim figure for 2013 is somewhat uncertain from the scan (confidence 0.5). No explicit gross 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table could be unambiguously read; a narrative reference to a 'negative gross incurred claims movement of GBP 4.0m' in the PI excess of loss account was located and quoted, but this may not represent the total gross prior-year development for the whole syndicate. Gross premium total is taken from the Technical Account 'Gross written premiums' line. Many note tables (technical provisions reconciliation, movement tables, segmental premium breakdown) were not fully legible so several fields are null or have reduced confidence.
